title: evergarden
excerpt: evergarden is a colorscheme inspired by lush forests, enchanted groves, and the calm of nature
content_html:
evergarden is a colorscheme inspired by lush forests, enchanted groves, and the calm of nature. It was also inspired by the lively art of The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap. It's designed to be easy on the eyes, elegant, and just plain nice to look at - whether you're coding, writing, or just staring at your terminal for fun (we won't judge).

by the way, you can try out the colors in your terminal by running: 

$ curl -L evergarden.moe
